resources.string: A pile of coins was hiding in the bush! +%1$s coins
Grow crops and tend your orchard
Not enough coins. Choose a cheaper crop or harvest a ripe plant.
Remove this plant? The seed is only refunded if it has never been watered.
Clear your first parcel. Buy seeds, plant, then water. Drag to explore; pinch to zoom.
%1$d × %2$s planted. Water them to start growing.
No free, cleared space for this seed.
Trees stay planted and grow without watering. Their fruit waits safely for your return. Picking starts a new cycle without replanting.
For a vegetable garden. Water after planting to start growth. Harvesting sells the crop and frees the space.
Seeds added to your stock and selected. Tap a cleared space to plant.
Expand your farm with 12 new spaces to clear. You can use this parcel as a vegetable garden or an orchard.
New parcel unlocked. Clear the ground to start planting.
Livestock is not available yet: animal sprites and gameplay are still to be added.
Remove or harvest all plants before changing the parcel use.
Ground cleared. Select seeds and tap here to plant.
Trees need an orchard; other crops need a vegetable garden. Tap the parcel sign to change its use.
No seeds of this type. Buy some from the shop or select another crop in stock.
%1$s planted. Tap again to water and start growth.
Watered. Ready in %1$s, even while away.
Garden map. Drag to move, pinch to zoom. Tap a parcel to buy it, or its sign to access individual spaces.
Reaps several plants in a single pull.
Watering mode on. Tap a thirsty plant, then tap again when the marker hits the highlighted zone.
Nothing to water here. Turn off watering mode with the can icon to plant or harvest.
Waters more ground from a single successful gauge.
Waters one plant at a time
Reset the whole farm to a fresh start
Your seed bag is empty. Visit the shop to choose your first crops.
A new corner of the garden. What it really sells is the seed below: more ground is the bonus.
Buy pens and breeding animals. Long press a pen to view counts and sell adults.
Drive your tractor through large fields. Sow, harvest and store wheat for your livestock.
Grow flowers, discover colours through crossing and make bouquets. Ready flowers wait for your return.

An adult male and female are required. Time between births, and then time to adulthood: chickens 2 days, sheep 3.5 days, pigs 5 days, cattle 7 days. Each female has one baby per cycle, even while away. Its sex is random. Food, water and shelter are included. Selling the last male stops the cycle. Each pen holds 48 animals.
Not enough coins, pen locked or pen full.
Includes a night shelter, feeding trough, outdoor water trough and decorations. Buy the animals separately.
Pen full. Sell adults to make room for births.
An adult male and female are needed to start breeding.
Next young animal grows up in %1$s
Guide the tractor with your finger, anywhere you like. The pass ends on its own at full coverage or when the tank runs dry.

Plough, sow, then harvest after 6 hours (also offline). Each pass ends on its own once the field is fully covered or the fuel runs out; an incomplete pass simply shrinks the field for the next one. Cover the entire field for +25% wheat. Hedges and tree stumps block the way and are redrawn every pass. Seeds are paid once per crop. Wheat can also boost young livestock.
Wheat ration: young animals grow twice as fast for up to 12 hours. No effect on reproduction. Animals already boosted cannot receive another ration yet.
Unlocked at %1$d harvests and %2$d large-field harvests · %3$d and %4$d so far
Sell all your stored produce · %1$d items?
Chance of an exceptional plant when you water.
Widens the zone to hit on the watering gauge.
A field never grows while the garden does, so the silo raises what a wheat grain is worth. It does not change how much wheat a pass brings in.
The orchard is being reworked. Fruit trees come back later.

Grown animals fill the pit on their own, even while the app is closed. Every seed you sow takes what it needs from it — as much as its rung on the ladder, so a pumpkin costs twelve and a radish one. A planting on manure grows in rich soil and sells for double, and that doubling stacks with a lucky harvest. Nothing to set: the pit empties itself into the ground.
%1$s planted in rich soil — double harvest. Tap again to water.
This device and another one have both been played since their last exchange. The two farms cannot be merged, so pick the one to keep — the other is replaced.
Farm from this device kept. It goes up to the cloud when you leave.
Farm from your other device restored.
Your neighbours would love some of your harvest. Their requests wait for you, even during a long break. Replacing one is free.
Any quality is welcome. Ordinary produce is used first; better quality is paid in full, plus a %1$d%% delivery bonus.
A little basket from your farm would inspire my next meal.
I want to cook something with local produce. Could you help?
My best recipes start with a good harvest. I will keep a place for yours.
My garden is taking a rest. Could you spare a little of your harvest?
I would love a basket to share with my family.
Your garden is looking lovely! Could I buy a few things from you?
I am gathering produce for a meal with the neighbours. Your basket would be welcome.
Let us show the village what grows here. Could you bring a little harvest?
A shared table, local produce, and good company. Will you join in?
Thank you! You have given me an idea for my next recipe.
Thank you, neighbour! Your basket will make everyone happy.
Thank you! There is a little of your farm in our village now.
A new request is waiting. Your harvest and friendship are unchanged.
Gather the whole basket before delivering.
Choose your seeds, then plant in an empty plot. The request will wait until you are ready.
Your neighbours are looking for some of these products. You can deliver their requests before selling.
Gather your harvest, plant your seeds, then water. The village baskets will wait for you.
Your first %1$d radish seeds are a gift. These first plants grow in %2$d seconds, so you can deliver a basket on your first visit.
%1$d spaces cleared. Ready for your seeds.
Malo left you %1$d radish seeds. Your garden can get going again.
Water and harvest an entire parcel with a tap. My visit handles the whole farm. No tool upgrade is needed.
Optional: tap when the marker is in the blue zone, twice. You can leave or use simple watering at any time.
Livestock unlocks at %1$d harvests · %2$d so far. The tractor is optional.
Each village delivery brings one helping hand to your chosen project. Switching projects keeps every contribution. Extra help waits in reserve. These places make your farm your own, at your pace.
Build a stone well with a tiled roof and a little flower bed. A peaceful landmark in your garden.
Dig a pond, fill it with water, then welcome reeds, water lilies and a duck.
Build a table and benches, then lay out a cloth and a basket for a quiet picnic.
Choose your next project. Helping hands in reserve: %1$d.
All three places are finished! Make them your own with your neighbours\' gifts.
%1$s. Next visible stage in %2$d helping hand(s).
\n%1$s is finished! Choose your next project.
Each neighbour has a gift for you after %1$d deliveries. Gifts wait until you collect them and are yours forever. Place them wherever you like, even before a project is finished.
This spot is ready for a decoration.
One decoration per place. Moving or replacing it is free; the previous object goes back into your collection.
Your decoration is safely back in your collection.
Your first purchased hen lays her first egg in 60 seconds. Later eggs take 24 hours.
Nothing collected. Ready produce stays safe, including when your inventory is full.
Hens lay eggs, sheep grow wool, cows give milk and pigs find truffles. Young animals begin when they grow up.
One ready item waits per animal, without spoiling. Collecting starts the next cycle. Eggs and milk: 24 hours; wool and truffles: 48 hours. No mate or petting required.
Animal produce keeps forever. Sell what you choose or keep it in your inventory.
Ordinary food and water are provided. Your animals and your bond stay safe while you are away. Grain rations are optional growth treats for the young.
Your animals greet you! %1$d new bond point(s).
Choose an animal to meet, name or pet. You can also tap an animal in its habitat.
No animals in this group yet.
This animal has already left the farm.
A pet adds one permanent bond point every 18 hours. Pet as often as you like between visits: your bond never decreases, and produce needs no care task.
%1$s is getting to know you better.
%1$s is happy to see you again. Your bond is safe.
Young animals are growing. Adult roosters and bulls help the herd have babies.
Up to %1$d characters. Leave blank to use the suggested name again.
Let %1$s leave the farm for %2$s coins?
This animal and its bond leave your farm. Any ready produce goes into your inventory first. If there is no room for it, the sale waits.
%1$s could not leave. Check your inventory space.
Choose what to make on your %1$d worktops. Each recipe makes one item. Worktops run independently, ready items wait forever, and collecting them never starts another batch.
Your first creation is ready in 60 seconds. Later creations use their normal recipe time.
Nothing collected. If a stock is full, the ready creation stays on its worktop.
Only ordinary crops are used. Higher qualities stay in your inventory.

Discover this recipe by unlocking its vegetables or pens, planting its fruit trees, growing its flowers, or keeping animals that produce its ingredients. Stored ingredients also count. Recipes using meat are optional.
%1$s is being prepared. It will wait for you.
Could not start %1$s. Check ingredients and free worktops; no ingredients were taken.
I would love this creation from your farm: %1$s.
A neighbour is asking for this creation. You can deliver it or choose to sell it.
See the workshop on the farm
No room for this harvest. Sell or use some stored fruit; the trees will keep their fruit ready.
Your very first tree bears fruit in one minute. Other trees use their normal growth time.
From two owned parcels, turn an empty parcel into an orchard for free. Keep at least one vegetable garden. Clear its debris before planting. To change back, remove its trees first.
%1$d fruit per harvest · %2$s coins each · first growth %3$s · then %4$s
Remove this tree permanently? It will stop producing fruit. The sapling is not refunded. Pick any ready fruit before removing it.
Each planter produces one cut flower. Flowers grow without watering and wait indefinitely. Picking frees the space; nothing is replanted automatically.
Your very first flower grows in one minute. Growing a known variety is free.
%1$d flowers added to your inventory. Discoveries stay in your journal.
%1$d flowers picked. If a stock is full, its flower waits in the planter.
Free to grow · %1$s · sells for %2$s coins
Planting started. Let it grow at your own pace.
Choose a free planter and check the flowers needed for crossing.
One cut flower from each parent produces this variety after 12 h. Guaranteed result. Collect it to add the discovery to your journal.
Your chosen variety blooms in the greenhouse borders and in the planter gifted by Lucie, once you own it. Changing varieties uses no flowers.
These flowers can also be used for crossing and bouquets. Discoveries stay in your journal even if you sell everything.
One visitor at a time, with all the time in the world to meet you. After a greeting, another may arrive a day later. Your encounters stay in this journal.
A small surprise: %1$d %2$s seeds and %3$s coins.
See the visitor by the garden
A quiet moment. Another visitor can arrive after a day. They will wait for your return, even if you stay away longer.
This surprise was already received or the seed bag is full. You can choose coins.
A robin hops by the garden. This looks like a place worth returning to for a song.
The little musician is back on the fence. Two notes, a pause, then a curious tilt of the head.
A red feather dances in the grass. Its owner recognises you and approaches in little hops.
A butterfly follows the colours of your greenhouse. It pauses between two flowers before greeting you.
In the sunshine, its wings look like little petals. It has found its favourite border again.
The butterfly circles you, then rests for a moment. The garden is as welcoming as ever.
A squirrel explores the orchard. Holding a hazelnut, it stops to get acquainted.
A red tail peeks out of the grass. The squirrel has hidden its supplies and comes to see what is growing.
The squirrel knows the way. It climbs a branch, looks at the fruit, then comes down to greet you.
A rabbit rests by the garden. Its ears rise as you approach, then it relaxes.
The rabbit has chosen a soft patch of grass. It lets you come closer and gently wiggles its nose.
Two long ears appear behind the fence. Your visitor is back to enjoy the peaceful farm.
An optional way to cook with your herd. Choose one adult, check its portions, then confirm. Animals are never processed automatically. Meat waits in your pantry without spoiling.
One adult gives %1$d portions · resale value %2$s
No adult available. Young animals need time to grow.

This permanently removes this animal and its bond from your farm. Its ready production is collected first. If either stock is full, nothing is processed. You can keep the portions, cook them or sell them.
This is the last adult male in this pen. Births will stop until another male joins the herd.
This is the last adult female in this pen. Births will stop until another female joins the herd.
%1$d portions of %2$s added to your pantry.
Could not transform this animal. Check that it is still an adult in your herd and that both stocks have room.
Unlock your first pen to choose an adult animal.
A few gestures, with no timer. Ingredients are only used when you start the final preparation. You can leave freely.
Swipe down along each of the four dotted lines on the board.
Trace two circles inside the pot, in either direction. Keep that direction while stirring.
Drag ingredients 1 to 4 onto the plate, in order.
Make one gesture with a button
Well prepared! This dish will be ready 20% sooner. Your first preparation keeps its 60-second introduction.
%1$s · %2$d percent. Activate to make one gesture.
Drag ingredients 1 to 4 onto the plate, in order. Next: %1$s.
Your recipes and cooking memories stay here. New pages appear as you collect different dishes and unlock their ingredients. Direct preparation counts too; there is no deadline.
Upcoming page: %1$s · %2$d different dishes and accessible ingredients
No bookmarked recipe in this category. Add bookmarks from your cookbook or show all recipes.
